overview: Based on the published agenda, the Outdoor Recreation Committee of the Village of Rothschild was scheduled to meet to consider actions regarding park expansion, offroad trail development, and winter trail maintenance agreements. The meeting was set to address multiple items affecting outdoor recreational opportunities in the village.
presiding: Elizabeth Felkner, Presiding Officer or Designee

agenda.item: Discussion and Possible Action Regarding the Cedar Creek Recreation Area Park Addition
Discussion and Possible Action Regarding Offroad Trails Within the Village of Rothschild
Discussion and Possible Action Regarding CWOCC Trail Maintenance Agreement for the 2026-2027 Winter Season
Set Date and Agenda Items to Discuss at Next Meeting

discussions.item: Cedar Creek Recreation Area Park Addition
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action regarding an expansion of the Cedar Creek Recreation Area Park. This item was set for review to determine next steps in developing additional recreational space within the village.

discussions.item: Offroad Trails Within the Village of Rothschild
discussions.body: The committee was set to discuss and consider possible action regarding offroad trails within village boundaries. This agenda item was expected to address planning, development, or regulation of offroad trail opportunities for residents.

discussions.item: CWOCC Trail Maintenance Agreement for the 2026-2027 Winter Season
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action on a trail maintenance agreement with CWOCC for the upcoming winter season. This item was expected to cover maintenance responsibilities and service expectations for winter trail management.
